description.zh:
该参数用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。参数值由客户端生成，保证在不同请求间唯一。

该参数值由ASCII字符组成，最长不超过64个字符，不能包含非ASCII字符。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
The instance ID You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.
The specification information of the node.

description.zh: 节点使用的虚拟交换机ID。
description.en: The vSwitch ID of the node.
The ID of the zone in which the node is deployed.

description.zh: 资源组ID。可调用DescribeDBInstanceAttribute接口获取。
description.en: The resource group ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the resource group ID.
